verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs confirm sandboxes exist for code execution (blaxel-docs-1, blaxel-docs-7) and can be customized via templates, but there is no explicit evidence of specific language runtime support (Python, JavaScript, etc.) or of structured/rich result output formats from executed code. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported language runtimes, documentation of output/result format (e.g., stdout, images, rich objects), and any hands-on demonstration of multi-language execution.
